title: The Protocol of Halcyon Drift
author: Hazel Ashgrove
blurb: Sable Blackwood, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
